user_direction: Natural-flick pilot was better; record the whole Mux flow first. No editing.

raw_master.post_capture_processing: none; no added blur, resize, compositing, retiming or re-encoding
raw_master.workflow: Inbox flick down and back up, approved family chat, conversation flicks, top-left back-button tap, verified inbox return.
raw_master.back_target: Unique semantic top-left accessible button, fresh bounds, recorded tap id back. No edge swipe.
raw_master.visual_checks: Native-size conversation and returned-inbox frames inspected. Original iOS glass effects remain; no privacy masks or replacement header.
raw_master.source_cadence_limit: Moving intervals still contain incoming frame gaps up to 100 ms. Retaining every received sample is not proof of perfect screen motion. Full raw take awaits user review.

recorder.fix: Wait for encoder readiness instead of silently discarding an incoming sample. Bound waiting to two seconds. Save diagnostics and reject reported frame loss rather than report a successful capture.

verification.launch_recovery: A transient CoreDevice 10004 cold-restart failure recovered with normal Argent launch. --current-inbox validates an already prepared registered inbox without unnecessary restart.
verification.warnings: Known macOS 27 AVFoundation deprecation warnings remain; native compilation and runtime checks passed.
verification.flow_note: New private take has a recorded flow; canonical legacy YAML was not changed and still describes earlier choreography. No new YAML-replay pass claimed.

safety: No app or framework code changed; no messages, reactions or deletions. Existing media unchanged, no uploads. Only this phone's Argent runner was released.
